correctness.rationale: The local minimized scalar quadratic has Hessian D=r+rho-a>0. Exact interior map M=1/D [[r,-1],[rho*r,r-a]]. Trace (2r-a)/D and determinant r/D; three Schur numerators are (rho-a)/D, rho/D and (4r+rho-2a)/D, yielding exactly rho>a and 4r+rho>2a. Discriminant (a²-4rho*r)/D² shows unique spectral-radius minimizer r*=a²/(4rho) with -a/(2rho-a) repeated eigenvalue. rho=a or 4r+rho=2a has a nondecaying mode. Independent SymPy algebra checked all identities; bundled exact-rational verify_palm_scalar.py inspected.
